tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Amino Desk's published pages on peptides and GLP-1 medications: compound entries, comparisons, guides, costs and legal status. Returns titles, URLs and snippets. Also finds brand names and seller code names mentioned on the site.

tools.name: list_compounds
tools.description: List the compounds Amino Desk covers, with evidence grade (A strongest to D weakest), US legal status and a one-line summary. All filters are optional.

tools.name: get_compound
tools.description: Get Amino Desk's full entry for one compound as Markdown: what it is, human evidence, US legal status, label or reported dosing with its source, safety and sources.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get any other Amino Desk page as Markdown, such as costs, providers, stacks, compare/semaglutide-vs-tirzepatide or guides/protein-on-glp-1. Use search to find the path.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
